integrity: The 72-facet model is reconstructed from the published census. The two integer cocycles, all 495 four-sets, the complete 60-support minimum layer, and an explicit 240-element facet-preserving symmetry group are replayed by the embedded standard-library verifier. The identification \(H_2(K;\mathbb Z)\cong\mathbb Z^2\) is a published topological premise.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact theorem for one 12-vertex triangulation. Vertex support is the size notion; no claim is made about geometric area or about longer homology representatives.
title: Two primitive homology directions exhaust the four-vertex \(H_2\)-systoles of a 12-vertex \(S^2\times S^2\)
